P082.title: Riding safety prediction of a high-speed train running on transition zone under foundation settlement
P082.authors: B Peng, X He, L Xu, Z Li, Y Guo
P082.label: Peng等（2024）

complete_examples.text: Settlement effects are simulated using the Newton-Raphson iterative method, with the additional rail deformation caused by foundation settlement serving as the excitation for the vehicle-track-transition zone dynamic interaction system.

In the numerical analysis, the dynamic effects of three key factors—train speed, transition zone length, and the amplitude of foundation settlement—are exam-ined based on the performance of the vehicle-track-transition zone interaction.
